selected_branches.branch: Passenger loading with a taxicab entrant

law_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than a bus in a bus stop, or a taxicab in a taxicab stand, when such stop or stand has been officially designated and appropriately signed, except that the driver of a passenger vehicle may temporarily stop there and for the purpose of and while actually engaged in expeditiously loading or unloading of passengers when such stopping does not interfere with any bus or taxicab waiting to enter or about to enter such zone.

topic_inventory.exact-text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than a bus in a bus stop, or a taxicab in a taxicab stand, when such stop or stand has been officially designated and appropriately signed, except that the driver of a passenger vehicle may temporarily stop there and for the purpose of and while actually engaged in expeditiously loading or unloading of passengers when such stopping does not interfere with any bus or taxicab waiting to enter or about to enter such zone.

runtime_uncertainties: Stand designation/sign and vehicle classifications require independently sourced original site/vehicle records before Native construction.
Original 900-frame Native capture, process-saved compatibility, exact offline and delivery receipts, canonical semantic proposals and full video audits remain CPU package work.
Physical motion and camera visibility require later CARLA verification.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed every frozen evidence inventory entry and its local accepted metadata; compared case identities and acceptance fields only. Physical equivalence and branch coverage remain unresolved.

witness_review.branch: Passenger loading with a taxicab entrant
required_context: Construct a usable narrow-road taxicab stand with highway, curb adjacency, designation and sign evidence.
Document traffic conflicts and police or official-device directions relevant to prohibited-stopping exclusions.
Establish stand geometry, highway status, official designation and sign evidence; preserve appropriately signed as unresolved.
Establish that the subject is not a taxicab, identify its driver and independently establish passenger-vehicle status.
Establish the entrant's motor-vehicle status, design or construction for no more than six passengers including the driver, and compensated passenger use.
Establish the other vehicle's taxicab classification, including capacity and compensated passenger use.
Independently establish the subject's passenger-vehicle status, non-taxicab use and driver identity.
Record actual passenger-loading purpose and activity throughout the stop.
Record entrant waiting, approach, access and physical effects throughout the subject's stop.
Record loading purpose and activity throughout the stop, entrant motion and waiting, access and physical effects; preserve temporarily, expeditiously, interference and about-to-enter meanings.
witness_review.reason: The other vehicle can be a qualifying taxicab approaching a designated stand while the subject loads passengers on the narrow road.
